title: Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper input

searchQueries.title: Advertiser names or domains to search
searchQueries.description: List of free-text advertiser searches as on adstransparency.google.com, e.g. ["Shopify", "nike.com"]. The best matches are scraped (count set by maxAdvertisersPerQuery). Provide at least one of searchQueries, advertiserIds, advertiserUrls or domains.

advertiserIds.title: Advertiser IDs
advertiserIds.description: Optional list of Google advertiser IDs starting with 'AR' followed by 20 digits, e.g. ["AR01614014350098432001"] (from /advertiser/AR... URLs). Scraped in addition to searchQueries.

advertiserUrls.title: Advertiser or creative URLs
advertiserUrls.description: Optional list of full adstransparency.google.com URLs, e.g. ["https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR01614014350098432001?region=US"]. Advertiser or creative URLs; scraped in addition to the other inputs.

domains.title: Domains (all advertisers)
domains.description: Optional list of website domains, e.g. ["nike.com"]. Returns ads from ANY advertiser linking to that domain (Google's search-by-website view), up to maxAdsPerAdvertiser per domain. Different from searchQueries, which finds advertisers by name.

maxAdvertisersPerQuery.title: Max advertisers per query
maxAdvertisersPerQuery.description: Integer 1-20 (default 1): how many best-matching advertisers to scrape for each searchQueries item. Does not affect advertiserIds, advertiserUrls or domains.

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Integer 1-100000 (default 100): max ads per advertiser (and per domain), newest first, fetched 40 per page. Each ad saved is a charged 'ad' event ($0.002); ad copy adds a second event. With onlyNewAds it limits how many newest ads are checked.

format.title: Ad format
format.description: Enum ALL, TEXT, IMAGE or VIDEO (default ALL): only return ads of this format.

regions.title: Regions (country codes)
regions.description: Optional list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. ["US", "GB", "KR"]: only ads shown in these countries. Empty list = all regions.

startDate.title: Shown after
startDate.description: Optional date string YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-01-01": only ads shown on or after this date. null = no limit.

endDate.title: Shown before
endDate.description: Optional date string YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-06-30": only ads shown on or before this date. null = no limit.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Enum ALL or POLITICAL (default ALL). POLITICAL restricts to election/political ads where Google provides that view.

includeAdText.title: Extract ad copy (text, links, images)
includeAdText.description: true (default) = also extract ad copy (headline, body, links, images; YouTube ID and thumbnail for videos). Text ads exist only as screenshots, so copy comes from OCR when ocrAdText is true. Adds 1-2 requests per ad and a separate 'ad-text' event ($0.003) charged only for ads where something was extracted. false = cheaper, metadata only.

ocrAdText.title: OCR screenshot ads
ocrAdText.description: true (default) = read the text of screenshot-only ads (most Search text ads) with Tesseract OCR, about 1 s per ad. Only used when includeAdText is true. false skips OCR; those ads then have no copy and no ad-text charge.

includeAdvertiserInfo.title: Include advertiser profile items
includeAdvertiserInfo.description: true (default) = also output one item per advertiser with type "advertiser" (name, ID, legal name, region, approximate ad count). Charged as one 'advertiser' event ($0.003) each. Set false to return only ad rows.

onlyNewAds.title: Only new ads (monitor mode)
onlyNewAds.description: Monitor mode (default false). true = remember seen ad IDs per advertiser/domain in historyStoreName and output and charge only ads not seen before; first run returns everything. Also adds a free 'advertiser-summary' row per advertiser. Schedule weekly with the same input.

historyStoreName.title: History store name
historyStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store holding seen ad IDs for onlyNewAds, e.g. 'google-ads-monitor' (default). Use one name per monitoring project and the same name on every scheduled run. Ignored when onlyNewAds is false.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings object, default {"useApifyProxy": true} (rotating datacenter IPs). Google shows a CAPTCHA after ~20 requests from one IP, so keep it enabled except for tiny runs.

adTextConcurrency.title: Ad text concurrency
adTextConcurrency.description: Integer 1-8 (default 4): how many ads fetch their preview/screenshot in parallel. Only speeds up CDN downloads; Google API calls stay sequential. Use 1 if many 'blocked' warnings appear.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Boolean (default false). true logs raw responses for troubleshooting; leave false.
